thread:
Mariela (sales): AdopterCo pilot tomorrow AM. Dry run flagged a few integration blockers. Can presales/eng triage?
Tom R (presales): Quick summary: intermittent SSE disconnects on long responses, tool-call JSON keys mismatch (snake_case vs camelCase), SSO refresh failing: `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Priya N (eng): SSE: their proxy closes idle after ~30s when big chunks stream. Our SDK keepalive default is 25s. Short-term fix: set heartbeat to 10s: `client.setHeartbeat(10000)` or env `SDK_KEEPALIVE=10s`.
Mariela (sales): Is that client-side only?
Priya N (eng): Yes. I'll add the snippet to the sample app and a config env.
Tom R (presales): JSON key mismatch breaks their deserializer. They expect camelCase but an adapter emits snake_case.
Priya N (eng): We'll include a small normalizer in examples: `normalizeKeys(resp, 'camelCase')`. Low risk.
Mariela (sales): SSO issue detail?
Tom R (presales): Edge connector refresh attempts client_credentials; their IdP needs a signed assertion. Logs: `invalid_grant: missing_assertion`.
Priya N (eng): Two options: (A) enable our session-exchange endpoint that accepts signed assertions (requires pilot entitlements/legal AUP) or (B) provision a delegated connector key (short-lived) — security may balk at long-lived creds.
Mariela (sales): Security prefers (A). Lead time?
Priya N (eng): We can enable session-exchange for the org in ~24-48 hrs after legal signs pilot AUP. I'll open JIRA `pilot-adopter-session-exchange`.
infra-bot: Deploy alert: `pilot-sampleapp` failed: EADDRINUSE on 8080.
Priya N (eng): Minor: change sample app to use ephemeral port (0) with fallback 8081. I'll include in the PR along with heartbeat + normalizeKeys. Draft PR: `pr/112-pilot-adopter-fixes`.
Tom R (presales): Pricing question: how are streaming vs non-streaming billed and are function/tool calls extra?
Priya N (eng): Billing is per-token emitted for both streaming and non-streaming. Tool/function calls add a small per-call metadata fee. For pilot we can cap spend and enable token-level telemetry and cost logs.
Mariela (sales): Action items: 1) I file JIRA and loop legal for AUP; 2) Priya pushes sample app PR; 3) Tom updates runbook with snippets and fallback steps; 4) infra redeploys sample app after PR.
Priya N (eng): Will ping here when PR is merged and when session-exchange is toggled. I'll standby during the run.
Mariela (sales): Thanks everyone :thumbsup: If needed we'll rollback to previous image and demo non-streaming calls as fallback.
Tom R (presales): I'll add troubleshooting checklist entries: heartbeat tweak, normalizeKeys, SSO options, EADDRINUSE fix.
Mariela (sales): End of thread. Will update after JIRA and PR merge.
